title: Agent Metadata Schema
description: Tool-agnostic metadata contract for generating platform-specific agent frontmatter (OpenCode, Google Antigravity / .gemini, Claude Code, and raw prompts).

$schema.description: Path or URI to this JSON schema.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier used in frontmatter and filenames.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the catalogue UI.

description.description: Concise summary injected into agent frontmatter for routing and discovery.

inspiration.description: Character or lore inspiration for the agent persona.

subagent.description: Whether the agent can be invoked as a subagent.

editMode.description: File mutation policy. Maps directly to Antigravity 'permissionMode'.

commandPolicy.description: Shell command execution policy. Maps to Antigravity 'commandExecutionPolicy'.

capabilities.description: Abstract tool capabilities mapped to platform-native tool names at build/download time.

prompt.description: Relative path to the markdown prompt file.

readme.description: Relative path to the human-readable overview README.

platformToolMapping.description: Reference mapping used by build scripts or GitHub Pages to translate abstract capabilities into platform-specific tool grants.
